senses.gloss: (= גלגל, v. גְּלַג; cmp. געגע = עגעג) to proclaim, boast.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 34:31">Targ. Y. I Gen. XXXIV, 31</cite> <he>מְלַגְלֵג במליה</he> ed. (Ar. <he>בנפשיה</he>; Y. II <he>מתגאי בליביה</he>).—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 64:10">Gen. R. s. 64</cite>, end <he>זיל תהא מלגלג וכ׳</he> go and announce it that thou didst put thy head into the lion’s mouth and camest out in peace; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 111">Yalk. ib. 111</cite>, end.
